title: General Data Processors
summary: This module provides a foundational mixin for building multimodal data processors, alongside specific implementations for models like ColModernVBert and GotOcr2, and a utility for English number normalization.

nodes.label: Raw Input Data
nodes.title: Raw Input Data
nodes.description: Unprocessed data including text, images, audio, and video, provided by the user.

nodes.label: Normalize Numbers in Text
nodes.title: English Number Normalizer
nodes.description: Converts numerical strings (e.g., '123', '$50', '50%') into their English word representations for improved text processing.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text
nodes.title: Text Tokenization Component
nodes.description: Converts raw text into numerical token IDs, handling special tokens, vocabulary lookups, and encoding.

nodes.label: Process Images
nodes.title: Image Preprocessing Component
nodes.description: Handles image loading, resizing, normalization, and other visual feature extraction tasks for models.

nodes.label: Extract Audio Features
nodes.title: Audio Feature Extraction Component
nodes.description: Processes raw audio signals into features suitable for model input, such as spectrograms or embeddings.

nodes.label: Process Video Frames
nodes.title: Video Preprocessing Component
nodes.description: Extracts and preprocesses frames from video inputs, preparing them for multimodal models.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Multimodal Preprocessing
nodes.title: Base Multimodal Processor
nodes.description: Provides a foundational framework for combining and coordinating text, image, audio, and video preprocessing steps into a unified input format.

nodes.label: ColModernVBert Data Processor
nodes.title: ColModernVBert Specific Processor
nodes.description: Extends the base processor to handle specific multimodal inputs and token replacements for the ColModernVBert model, including visual prompts and query augmentation.

nodes.label: GotOcr2 Data Processor
nodes.title: GotOcr2 Specific Processor
nodes.description: Extends the base processor to manage multi-page image inputs, bounding box annotations, and OCR-specific prompt construction for the GotOcr2 model.

nodes.label: Model-Ready Batch
nodes.title: Model-Ready Batch
nodes.description: The final, preprocessed batch of data, formatted and ready for input into a machine learning model.

groups.label: Core Processing Framework
groups.title: Core Processing Framework
groups.description: The foundational components that provide common logic and orchestration for multimodal data preparation.

groups.label: Model-Specific Processors
groups.title: Model-Specific Processors
groups.description: Concrete implementations of multimodal processors tailored for specific model architectures and their unique input requirements.

groups.label: Data Transformation Utilities
groups.title: Data Transformation Utilities
groups.description: Helper components focused on specific data manipulation tasks, such as text normalization, that can be integrated into the preprocessing pipeline.

groups.label: External Preprocessing Tools
groups.title: External Preprocessing Tools
groups.description: Components from other modules or libraries that handle the low-level processing of individual data modalities (text, images, audio, video).
